approved_translation: True generosity does not boast; what is given freely is more valuable than gold.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time there was a Goose who had beautiful golden feathers. Not far away from this Goose lived a poor, a very poor woman, who had two daughters. The new ones that come in are not golden, but plain white. As time went on his feathers grew again, and then he flew away to his home and never came back again.
